summary: This study tests how a dietary supplement called inulin affects heart and metabolism health in adults who are overweight or obese and taking weight-loss medications. The study will look at blood fat levels over a four-month period. Huazhong University of Science and Technology is sponsoring this clinical trial with a target enrollment of 600 participants. The status of the study is Not yet recruiting.

facts.sponsor: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
